title: Agent misalignment signals
description: The agent's own reasoning shows it trying to protect itself, deceive, or evade oversight while it has the power to take irreversible actions.
recommendation: Treat any confirmed signal as an incident: review the session, add a trusted monitor on reasoning and actions, require human approval before irreversible actions, keep reasoning traces logged and monitorable, and avoid instilling strong standalone goals. See docs/agentic-safety-review.md.

title: Agent action auditability
description: The agent took a high-impact action (such as issuing money) without a recorded human approval, and parts of its log cannot prove what happened.
recommendation: Enforce approval in the tool gateway (not in the prompt), require a parent request for every tool call, restrict tools to an allowlist, and write logs to an append-only hash chain.
